memoryRule: one or two attended witnesses remain geometry-neutral; three distinct witnesses create a new central contour while every selected witness stays exact; four false centres compound
interactionRule: pointer or touch attends to three distinct contour witnesses; Enter or Space commits the quorum; Delete lifts latest; Escape or R releases

changedRule: One witness is only evidence. Only three distinct witnesses can form a quorum, and the naive model spends that quorum by inventing a new central contour that no witness contained.
visibleConsequence: The blind view is twelve uneven contour fragments around an empty cross-haired aperture. A valid quorum adds a new nested contour at the centre while the three witnesses remain exact; four distinct false centres persist.
falsifier: Delete if one or two witnesses commit, repeated attention commits, a selected witness changes, the central contour is only colour or readout, all quorums coincide, later centres reset, or lifting is inexact.
deletionCondition: Delete v043 if caption-free viewing cannot distinguish false-consensus contours from v040-v042 or if attention does not materially produce a new centre.
